characteristics.name: Lore
characteristics.$text: Viresk demilitarized years before the arrival of the Valerius Alliance and the conflict that spurred forth from it. When the fighting between the Vireskians, Partisans, Valerius Alliance and the other groups that came forth from the planet to exploit the conflict, these soldiers donned their aged military gear to protect their home once more.

rules.name: Warriors Past their Prime
rules.description:
A Unit with this special rule has the following effects below:
• A Unit with this special rule performs charges at normal movement value.
• Fallback movements that this unit performs are reduced by D6.
• Any Panic Actions on this unit are ignored.
• A Unit with this special rule +1 Ballistic Skill.
• A Unit with this special rule suffers -1 to Initiative in Melee Combat.

characteristics.name: Lore
characteristics.$text: The Guhlimhurian were a Order of an ancient Vireskian Order that could be beckoned by the High Council. Despite having an outdated arsenal, the master-crafted weaponry of the Guhlimhurians makes up for it as they cut through the armor of both metal and energy with ease.

rules.name: Order of Yore
rules.description:
A Unit with this special rule has the following effects below:
• A unit with this special rule can charge terrain pieces that would otherwise not allow you to charge into/through.
• Any Challenges that target a unit with this special rule must be accepted.
• A unit with this special rule cannot be affected by Panic, 50% Casualty Test or Overwhelmed.

characteristics.name: Lore
characteristics.$text: From the tense conditions of the Valerius Alliance's prescence on Viresk, the Underworld Empire of Vireskian mercenaries and Criminal hit it's peak as peddling technology, mercenaries, ambushes and attacks in the uniforms of both sides become common place and creating great mistrust between the two sides while filling the pockets of the criminal lords and bloodthirsty mercenaries.

rules.name: Enforcers of the Vireskian Underworld
rules.description:
A Unit with this special rule has the following effects below:
• A Unit with this special rule may draw line of sight through one friendly unit to enemy units, however any failed hit rolls are treated as successful "to wound" rolls on that friendly unit.
• A Unit with this special rule counts as +1 Toughness in Melee Combat.
• A Unit with this special rule has +1 Movement, which is doubled for the sake of charges.

characteristics.name: Lore
characteristics.$text: The Naval Hunters were not only a maritime company of fishers, hunters and explorers, but also as an emergency force when called upon to protect Vireskian territories near the waters or act as an additional force deeper in the mainland.

rules.name: Vareskian Naval Discipline
rules.description:
A Unit with this special rule has the following effects below:
• A Unit with this special rule cannot have their movement reduced below their native value.
• A unit with this special rule does not suffer negative modifiers to Initiative in Melee Combat.

characteristics.name: Lore
characteristics.$text: The Citizens of Viresk were particularly passive until they were agitated by Partisans and Destabilizers that wish profit in the fighting; the Citizens of Viresk armed themselves against these offenders.

rules.name: Civilian Defenders of Viresk
rules.description:
A Unit with this special rule has the following effects below:
• When two or more units are within 12 inches and line of sight of each other, they cannot suffer a Fallback Action.
• A Unit with this special rule has +1 to Willpower and Discipline.
• A Unit with this special rule suffers a -1 to their Ballistic Skill if their shooting target is more than half their weapon's range away from them.

rules.name: Unruly Rebels
rules.description:
A Unit with this special rule has the following effects below:
• A unit with this special rule may deploy at the start of the game inside a terrain feature as long as they can fit WHOLLY within or is below/equal to the the capacity limit of the terrain feature.
• A unit with this special rule inside a Terrain Feature where fighting can occur has +1 Strength and +1 Toughness when fighting inside said-terrain feature.

characteristics.name: Lore
characteristics.$text: The Guerilla Fighters of Viresk were born from the decades of turmoil that resurrected when the Valerius Alliance had to land on Viresk for refueling and resources, many of these groups seeked violence against these outsiders and soon sparked the conflicts between the Alliance and the aggressive factions on Viresk. Despite being outlawed and labeled as traitors by the High Council of Twelve, the various Partisans and Rebels seek warfare and destruction for their causes.

characteristics.name: Abilities
characteristics.$text: Melee, Brutal Strike(3), Anti-Armor, Unprepared Strike(3)

rules.name: Guhlimhurian Armor
rules.description: This armor provides a 6+ Primary Save against Ballistic and Melee Weapons.

characteristics.name: Lore
characteristics.$text: From the rough translation from the Vireskian language, the council executioners were those who carried out their namesake, hunting down and killing any Vireskian tied to the High Council they could find. The group was not the first to form, however they were the first to commit the great atrocities that the Guerillas would be recognized for.

rules.name: Fragile Demonizing
rules.description:
To represent the propaganda spouted, Chainbreaker INFANTRY Units have +2 Discipline and Willpower, however when they fail their first test using their Discipline or Willpower, they lose this bonus. If the unit is Regular or Veteran, it is instead reduce to +1.


An army that is fully composed of Chain-Breakers Units may have an allied Organization Chart of "Civilian Defenders of Viresk"

characteristics.name: Lore
characteristics.$text: Chain-Breakers are those who inspired uprisings and freeing their own kin from captivity to gain more fighters for their cause. They were the first to form out of the three majorly known organizations, dehumanizing both the High Council and Valerius Alliance to be seen as two greater evils, this propaganda would spur them further; their leadership preying on the emotions of their fighters.

rules.name: Proper Training
rules.description:
To represent the training by the Valerius Alliance, this unit has +1 to Ballistic Skill and +1 to Melee Skill.


An army that is fully composed of People's Torch Units may be taken as an allied army organization chart.

characteristics.name: Lore
characteristics.$text: The People's Torch are partisans and fighters alike that allied themselves with the Valerius Alliance and the High Council against the growing unrest that the Vireskian Underworld and other Guerilla Fighters were causing. While not supplied by the Valerius Alliance, they were given additional training so that both groups could coordinate more effectively.

rules.name: Section
rules.description:
When deploy onto the battlefield, units within this unit (either at the start of the battle or when arriving from Reserves), are treated independently for deployment and afterwards.


Example: If you have 3 Units of  Medics Teams in a Section, they act independently from one another, they are all separate units from each other. So Medic A doesn't have to be in coherency with B and C, and they can deploy and act freely. They just share the same slot in the organization chart.

characteristics.name: Lore
characteristics.$text: Summoning a great mass of water from the very liquid in the ground, it is super heated by an unseen anger and sent in a tide towards the foe.

characteristics.name: Lore
characteristics.$text: The mage brings forth an ethereal mist that possesses them and those who join them, and when they die, the mist acts as a physical after-image that carries their host's weapons for one final strike; mimicking the tale of yore.

rules.name: Kavai's Final Strike
rules.description:
Casting Cost:2
Target: This Mage/Unit it is attached to.
Effect: All Models in the unit gain the "Kavai's Final Strike" Effect. During melee combat, any models from this unit that is removed from play still get to perform an Melee Attack action at Initiative 1; This applies even if the unit is fully wiped out or the unit has fought before their death.
Conditions: A Mage with this effect already applied cannot have it applied again, and cannot be applied to a unit twice. A Unit or Model with this effect cannot be revived; such examples is a model being returned by the Medic Special rule.

characteristics.name: Lore
characteristics.$text: The Mage crumbles buildings with the great weight of the seas and turn even the most sturdy of strongholds into tombs.

rules.name: Sink the Lands
rules.description:
Casting Cost:3
Target: A Terrain Piece that is a Fortification, Dangerous Terrain or Very Dangerous Terrain within Line of Sight and 24 Inches. 
Effect: That terrain piece becomes a Dangerous Terrain Piece until end of the round. If it already was a Dangerous Terrain Piece, make it into a Very Dangerous Terrain Piece. If it was a Fortification, force it's respective test. (Example: A Light Fortification Test would be forced on all units inside of a Light Fortification.

rules.name: Master of Kavai
rules.description:
A Master of Kavai knows all Six Spells of the Arcana of Kavai and can dispel one Psychic and Magic Spell per round for no cost.


A Mage of this level may use any amount of spells to the amount of their level. For example: A Level 4 Mage can use 2 Level 2 Spells in a round or 4 Level 1 Spells, so on and so forth.

rules.name: Adorned Robes
rules.description: This armor provides a 8+ Primary Save against Ballistic and Melee Weapons.

characteristics.name: Lore
characteristics.$text: A Chosen of Kavai is Shipmistress or Naval Baroness who has embarked across the Oryx Fiord, an area of great alteration as both sights and sounds are ghastly, and came out more sane and prophetic than shaken and possibly insane. Believed to be a disciple of Kavai the Eternal, they guide their crews with superior skill and and Arcane Casting.
